svg.title: Russia holds nearly a fifth of Ukraine
svg.desc: Situation map covering 21.5°E to 40.7°E, 44.0°N to 53.0°N. Approximate open-source positions, circa 2024 · roughly 18% occupied. Areas of control in 2 classes: Russian-occupied (approx.), Contested (approx. front line) (contested). An approximate front line is drawn. Marked: Contested flashpoint. Schematic polygons drawn by hand from open-source reporting, not a geocoded dataset. Every zone is drawn as assessed control from open-source reporting; no claimed-only or reported-only ground is shown separately. Natural Earth basemap; the Kakhovka Reservoir is drawn as former (drained after the dam breach of 6 June 2023). Positions as of ~2024 · illustrative, not operational intelligence. 8 mapped features can be reached with the Tab key, each one naming what it is. The map draws the assessment it was given; it does not verify who holds what.
